subject: English
question_text: Complete the following passage using suitable connectors:
stimulus: Women are nowadays as important as men in the society. They constitute nearly half of our total ⎯⎯ ⎯⎯ population. (a) there can be no denying the fact (b) they too possess equal rights and duties (c) ⎯⎯ men do. They have noble mission to fulfil as men. (d) ⎯⎯ they get opportunity, their genius, powers (e) ⎯⎯ capacities will bloom fully.
guide_solution: (a) In fact (b) that (c) as (d) If (e) and
source: SSC English 2nd-paper Mymensingh Board-2020 (Board Question With Solution)
flag_note: Gap letters in question ['c', 'd', 'e'] differ from solution letters ['a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'e'].
